lead.t: ICP may exceed 30 cm H2 O and cerebral perfusion may be further compromised if the cerebral perfusion pressure (mean arterial pressure minus mean ICP) is < 50 mm Hg as a result of systemic hypotension.

snip.t: Monitoring intracranial pressure can be useful in preventing severe cerebral edema, in maintaining cerebral perfusion pressure, and in establishing the suitability of a patient for liver transplantation.
